description: Read one social post: its main text, hashtags, images, linked product, status and schedule, and per channel the text that channel gets (ownText or the main text), its length against the channel limit, whether the channel is ready, and what publishing returned there — status, link to the live post (permalink) or the network's error. Read-only. Use list_content_posts to find the id; call it after publish_content_post to report the links.

id.description: The publication id returned by create_content_post or list_content_posts.

name: get_content_post
title: Get post
